props.text:
btc looks solid amid massive ai sell off (potential bubble proof) and saylor selling. on-chain arguably in a new cycle already

price has consolidated the whole summer and 7d+30d+90d rvwaps are lining up around yearly poc where price has been auctioning a lot lately. we are now trading comfortably above the yearly poc + 7d+30d rvwaps for a bit, picture looks decent

weak low at 57k still there and to be run eventually in this year im pretty sure that happens, but FOR NOW - take out the 90d rvwap + 67k zone and a fast trending move up in on the cards that would target 71k 2026 avwap and 74k 2026 vah. inval is pretty easy, everything below yearly poc + 30d rvwap i would say points to sweep of 57k and new lows

i really enjoy on-chain more rn & will post more going forward. feel like thats a better place to be rn and if you want to bet on that, lots of sharp ppl added pump coin to their good holds list, i think that makes sense

enjoy the new week lads
